full_judgment:
Md. Abdul Karim, J: This appeal is directed against the judgment and decree dated 30.5.1995 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge and 3rd Artha Rin Adalat, Dhaka, in Money Suit No. 469 of 1990 decreeing the suit. 

 4. The trial court considered that in view of the failure of the supplier to supply goods as per the contract, the defendant No. 1 Habib Bank Lid was bound to pay 10% of the value of the said contract on the basis of Bank guarantee No. 46/85 dated 2.10.1985 furnished by them in favour of the purchaser. With this finding the trial court decreed the suit in favour of the plaintiff. Being aggrieved by this judgment and decree, defendant No. 1 Habib Bank Ltd. has preferred this appeal. 

 6. Mr. Zakir Hossain, learned Advocate appearing for the plaintiff Bangladesh Railways, submits that the Bank guarantee No. 46/85 dated 2.10.1985 is an unconditional guarantee by defendant-appellant Habib Bank Ltd. to pay the purchaser upon his demand without reference to the supplier 10% of the value of the said contract for non-fulfillment of any condition of the contract. In this case the supplier having not fulfilled the terms of the contract, it is a legal right of the buyer to demand encashment of the Bank guarantee and the trial court rightly decreed the suit for encashment of the Bank guarantee. 

 The court below was wrong in holding that in the facts and circumstances of the case, the Bank guarantee was encashable. We therefore find it difficult to uphold the judgment and decree passed by the court below. 

 14. In the result, the appeal is allowed. The judgment and decree passed by the court below is set aside. Money Suit No. 469/1990 is dismissed. Send down the case records at once.
